people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Hachilah
people.line: A hill in the Wilderness of Ziph, near David's hideout.

people.name: Jeshimon
people.line: A wilderness near Ziph, where David hid from Saul

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

people.name: Ziph
people.line: A town in Judah where David hid from Saul

translations.web: The Ziphites came to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert?”
translations.bsb: Then the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah and said, “Is not David hiding on the hill of Hachilah, opposite Jeshimon?”
translations.kjv: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?
translations.asv: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert?
